product.name: Buy Now, Pay Later
product.description: A service allowing users to purchase consumer goods and services and pay in installments over up to 36 months, with no down-payment and starting at 0% interest.

product.name: Instant Credit Approval
product.description: Users can get instant credit approval by downloading the app and providing their ID, or by applying in-store through partner merchants.

product.name: Flexible Installment Payments
product.description: Users can settle their monthly installments through various methods such as Fawry, Aman, Masary, e-wallets like Vodafone Cash, or with a credit card.

product.name: Partner Merchant Program
product.description: A program for merchants to become Shahry certified partners, allowing them to offer installment payment options to their customers and potentially increase sales.
